info.title: CS-VB Public Members Summary Generator
info.description: Generates and integrates a summary of public API members in your C# or VB.NET source-code files.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
│   This application analyzes C# and VB.NET source-code files (*.cs and *.vb) to    │
│   generate a specialized summary of public members that is directly inserted on   │
│   top of each source file through a new '#region' directive, providing a clear    │
│   and updated overview for the publicly accessible members of your API.           │
│     - Ctors, properties, fields, events, methods, operators, delegates and enums. │
│   supporting UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32, with or without a Byte Order Mark (BOM).  │
│   This application is shared 'as-is', without any warranty; Use at your own risk. │
│   Ensure to make a backup of your CS/VB files before using this application.      │

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recursively process source-code files in all subdirectories.

options.name: --test
options.description: Runs the application in Test Mode (dry-run), simulating the entire process without modifying actual files.

arguments.name: DIRECTORY_PATH
arguments.description: The path to the root directory containing the *.cs or *.vb source-code files to process.
